description: This is a test class for the NotesRepository component in the Android client of Nextcloud Notes. It contains unit tests for various functionalities such as account management, note operations, synchronization status, and search features, utilizing mocking frameworks and in-memory database for testing.

classes.name: NotesRepositoryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the NotesRepository functionalities in the Android client of Nextcloud Notes.

methods.name: setupDB
methods.description: Initializes in-memory database, mocks API responses, and sets up test accounts and notes before each test.

methods.name: closeDb
methods.description: Closes the in-memory database after each test.

methods.name: testGetInstance
methods.description: Verifies that the singleton instance of NotesRepository is correctly returned.

methods.name: testGetIdMap
methods.description: Tests retrieval of note ID mappings for different accounts.

methods.name: testAddAccount
methods.description: Tests adding a new account with mocked SSO response.

methods.name: testAddNote
methods.description: Tests adding new notes and verifies their status and excerpt.

methods.name: updateApiVersion
methods.description: Tests updating the API version string for an account, including validation of proper handling of invalid values.

methods.name: moveNoteToAnotherAccount
methods.description: Tests moving a note from one account to another, verifying note properties and method calls.

methods.name: testSyncStatusLiveData
methods.description: Verifies the synchronization status LiveData updates correctly during sync operations.

methods.name: testSyncErrorsLiveData
methods.description: Checks that sync errors are correctly reported after failed sync attempts.

methods.name: updateDisplayName
methods.description: Tests updating the display name of an account, including handling null and blank values.

methods.name: searchLexicographically
methods.description: Tests lexicographical search of notes, but is ignored due to localization issues.
